descriptor: Messaging app that stays useful without a connection

voice.summary: A harbour pilot's steady voice when the signal drops: unbothered, practical and a little wry. It names the problem, says what still works and keeps you company while you wait.
dos: Say what still works while offline
Give one concrete thing to try, such as check your Wi-Fi
Keep the humour light and the instructions clear
donts: Panic words like failure or crash

boilerplate: Harbourline is a messaging and reading app that keeps recent pages available offline and reconnects automatically when the network returns.

microcopy.error: Still offline. Try again in a moment

logo.note: A bolt of connection and breaking contact fits the plug-and-socket story of the offline page.
